title: Find Yourself – The Many Worlds
meta: Output: 4K/HD digital video (MP4/MOV), seamless loop; USB, download, or NFT
statement:
Find Yourself: The Many Worlds is a looping short film born from a deeper body of work exploring identity, presence, and emotional transformation.

Rooted in a series of visual artworks, the film extends an ongoing inquiry into the nature of the self — and the quiet, often nonlinear paths we take to find it. Mushroom-headed figures move through surreal, symbolic environments: mirrored voids, womb-like spaces, cloud corridors, and flooded dreamscapes. Each realm reflects a part of the soul — not as it is, but as it is becoming.

A whispered inner voice acts as a guide — gentle, observational, and at times disoriented — narrating not what is seen, but what is felt. These spoken fragments are layered with ambient soundscapes, composed to support slow viewing, emotional pacing, and atmospheric immersion.

The film was not storyboarded in advance. It emerged intuitively — scene by scene — as a visual meditation. It exists not to explain, but to evoke. Each loop offers a new possibility: another version of the self, searching, surfacing, shifting.

Format: 48-second 4K UHD looping video
